lessons: Four limited-history fallback ATGs qualified for Official Playable and all four lost.
Playable v0.3 correctly quarantined all four fallback ATGs, but its lone Toronto ML selection lost.
Goalie v0.1 and v0.2 went 4-4 on identical directions; v0.1 had slightly better Brier and expected-saves MAE on this slate.
Current-season ATG shadow was more calibrated by Brier than official ATG top10 but hit fewer scorers (2-8 vs 3-7); one slate is insufficient for promotion.
Top10 puck-line subset went 2-3; goalie subset went 3-1; Tampa ML lost.
No official predictive model structural change is justified from this single restart slate.
